subject: Project Sirocco kickoff: CFQ as a first-class eval product
body:
Hi Santiago,

Kicking off the CFQ productization. Internally we're calling this effort Project Sirocco — please use the codename in docs and channel names so search stays clean.

Context: our open-source CFQ release (the ICLR 2020 compositional generalization work) is still the reference benchmark in the space, but internally it's a pile of scripts. Goal is to make it a supported eval product on the data-platforms stack: hosted dataset, one-command train/eval, and a leaderboard over the three MCD splits ranked by MCD-MEAN.

Why now: two language teams asked for compositional-generalization evals in Q1 planning and both were about to hand-roll their own.

Milestones (Feb 2 – May 18): hosted dataset + eval harness by mid-March, leaderboard live mid-April, launch review by early May.

Santiago — resourcing thoughts by end of week?

Dmitri
